newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin up eight cents to 13.85 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin up eight cents to 13.85 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's spot tin price ended eight cents higher at 13.85 ringgit ($5.42) a kg on Tuesday after players reacted positively to a strong overnight close on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
The weaker ringgit against the U.S. dollar also made Malaysian tin attractive, said the traders. The closing price on Tuesday was at a discount of $30 against the LME.
"I think the next resistance level for the market now is 14 ringgit," said a trader.
Traders noted initial bids for 221 tonnes against offers for 157. Final turnover was 217 tonnes, against 120 on Monday, and was absorbed by Europeans, Japanese and locals.
